title: ДО + genitive: Till evening, before lunch

items.text: 1. До + Gen. meaning „till“ or „to“ (indicating a time limit of an action): Дождь шёл до вечера. 2. До + Gen. meaning „before“ (answering the question „when?“): Сегодня он пришёл домой до обеда. Они жили здесь до войны.
The preposition „до“ + Gen. simply means „before“ without any emphasis on the closeness to the event.

blocks.text: DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 75 and 77. One sentence at a time, in a new order each time you open this chapter; it is finished when every one has been answered right. The sentences are real: the source of each is shown with it.
